# HTTP API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the FastAPI routes. Do not edit. -->

Base path `/v1`. Every route except `GET /v1/health` requires the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. See docs/service.md for the security model and the job states.

| Method | Path | Auth | Success | Body | Query | Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/analyses` | bearer | 200 |  | `limit`: Limit = 50 | list analyses |
| `GET` | `/v1/analyses/{job_id}/files` | bearer | 200 |  |  | analysis files |
| `GET` | `/v1/analyses/{job_id}/files/{file_path:path}` | bearer | 200 |  |  | analysis file |
| `GET` | `/v1/analyses/{job_id}/qc` | bearer | 200 |  |  | analysis qc |
| `GET` | `/v1/health` | none | 200 |  |  | health |
| `GET` | `/v1/jobs` | bearer | 200 |  | `status`: str | None = None; `limit`: Limit = 50 | list jobs |
| `POST` | `/v1/jobs` | bearer | 202 | `SubmitRequest` |  | submit |
| `GET` | `/v1/jobs/{job_id}` | bearer | 200 |  |  | get job |
| `POST` | `/v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` | bearer | 202 |  |  | cancel job |
| `POST` | `/v1/validate` | bearer | 200 | `ValidateRequest` |  | validate |

## Error codes

| Code | HTTP status |
| --- | --- |
| `bad_request` | 400 |
| `internal` | 500 |
| `invalid_config` | 422 |
| `invalid_request` | 422 |
| `job_finished` | 409 |
| `not_completed` | 409 |
| `not_found` | 404 |
| `path_not_allowed` | 403 |
| `plugins_disabled` | 422 |
| `queue_full` | 429 |
| `unauthorized` | 401 |
| `unavailable` | 503 |

Every error has the body `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. A job that ends `failed` carries one of the job error codes instead: `invalid_config`, `not_found`, `path_not_allowed`, `batch_refused`, `io_error`, `internal` or `interrupted`.
